## PRISMA — Glacier Agency | Website Development, Logo & Branding, Digital Marketing & SEO, and Graphic Design Services
URL: https://glacieragency.com/prisma
Type: page
brand: Glacier Agency | Website Development, Logo & Branding, Digital Marketing & SEO, and Graphic Design Services

Prisma is a classified automation system that keeps listings consistently at the top of major classified platforms without relying on paid ad boosts. It uses intelligent reposting and rotation to maintain visibility and engagement. Security is a core focus, with built-in safeguards that prevent bans, blocks, or detection by classified systems.

---

## KAELIS — Glacier Agency | Website Development, Logo & Branding, Digital Marketing & SEO, and Graphic Design Services
URL: https://glacieragency.com/kaelis
Type: page
brand: Glacier Agency | Website Development, Logo & Branding, Digital Marketing & SEO, and Graphic Design Services

Kaelis is a stress testing platform built to push systems to their operational limits and uncover hidden vulnerabilities. It simulates high-demand scenarios and extreme usage conditions to evaluate performance, stability, and scalability. Designed with security and reliability in mind, it ensures safe execution without risking system integrity or triggering defensive blocks.
